column1: # Triage of the error markers mangosd writes to server_<timestamp>.log (#36),
# at startup and at runtime.
# Columns: class <TAB> phase <TAB> pattern [<TAB> tracking issue]
#   class   fatal | known-data | known-runtime | known-bot (bot finding with
#           an open issue: tolerated by the smoke, tracked in that issue)
#   phase   startup (before "World server is up and running") | runtime | any
#   pattern POSIX ERE, matched against the message in LOWER CASE with the
#           "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS " prefix removed.
# The first matching row wins. A marker that matches no row is "unknown", and
# live-smoke.sh fails on unknown and fatal markers: extend this file only after
# looking at the new pattern, never by widening a rule to make a run pass.
# Baselines:
# - train 2 start 2026-09-25 14:21 UTC (core fc6afb9e): 1568 markers, 157
#   distinct patterns, all "ERROR:" lines written while the world database
#   loads; 4 markers (3 patterns) after world-up.
# - train 1 run 2026-09-24 17:18 UTC, ~21 h (core 72b952ce): 1563 startup, 915
#   runtime markers in 12 patterns, all listed below.
fatal
# World-database integrity reports while loading (creature_movement paths for
# missing GUIDs, loot templates without creature, unknown spell categories,
# missing broadcast texts, ...). The core skips or repairs the row and loads on.
# They are data debt, not a runtime fault; they are counted, never ignored.
known-data
# A bot repeatedly routing to an unreachable point 55-80 yd higher near
# Ironforge, dying on the way (60 of 61 events one bot in train 1). Upstream
# debug detector at error level; the loop itself is tracked in #335.
known-bot
# World scripts and waypoints referring to content that is absent or not
# loaded (script targets, conditions without target, creatures without a
# waypoint path). The core skips the action; content debt, not a fault.
known-runtime
column3: ^error:condition [0-9]+ type [0-9]+ used with bad parameters, called from script action

column1: known-runtime
column3: ^error:findscripttargets: failed to find target for script with id [0-9]+

column1: known-runtime
column3: ^error:script_command_start_waypoints \(script id [0-9]+\) call for a nullptr or non-creature source

column1: known-runtime
column3: ^error:waypointmovementgenerator::loadpath: guid [0-9]+ entry [0-9]+ doesn't have waypoint path$

column3: ^error:creature [0-9]+ \(entry: [0-9]+\) have unit_npc_flag_vendor but have empty trading item list\.$
